name: PHP2Shell
summary: Two critical remote code execution flaws in PHP core (CVSS 9.2). Exploitable without authentication; can also leak memory containing secrets.

ini_conditional.note: PHP 8.5 only: closes the fatal-error backtrace path flagged in the advisory.
Caps request size to shrink the out-of-memory attack surface. Applied only when the current limit is larger than 32M, never raised, so a site already set tighter is left alone.

advice: Update PHP to a fixed version (8.2.35, 8.3.36, 8.4.27 or 8.5.12). Until then, turn on the shield to apply PHP's recommended stopgap settings. For a cap applications cannot override at runtime, apply the host-level php_admin_value form shown under the manual snippet.
